# 2 Baruch Chapter 45 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**1** Meditate therefore on these things in your hearts and fix your minds upon the law — and wisdom will instruct you for your good.

**2** And I, Baruch, say this to you — you who are here: keep in your hearts all that I have commanded you, so that you may not forget it.

**3** For I know that the earth will surely change in that time, and that the heavens will not remain as they are; and that the times will pass away; and that the Most High will renew his whole creation.

**4** And those who have been purified by wisdom will be transformed; and the appearance of their face will be turned into the light of beauty; and they will be made like the stars.

**5** For what is written in the law will be fulfilled; and all who have not believed will not be able to resist it.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering. The chapter closes with the glorious transformation of the righteous (v.4) — one of 2 Baruch's most celebrated passages. Transformation into starlight echoes Dan 12:3. The certainty that the law will be fulfilled (v.5) grounds the whole exhortation.*
